### Problem 15 Solution

We can use the Josephus problem formula to directly compute the position of the survivor in \(O(\log N)\) time.

The recursive formula for the Josephus problem is:
\[ J(n, k) = \begin{cases} 
0 & \text{if } n = 1 \\
(J(n-1, k) + k) \mod n & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases} \]

Since we need to get the position starting from 1, we will add 1 to the result.

### Using Python Code to Solve

def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    N = inputs['N']
    K = inputs['K']
    
    def josephus(n, k):
        if n == 1:
            return 0
        else:
            return (josephus(n - 1, k) + k) % n
    
    return josephus(N, K) + 1

}
